owner_calls.question: X-Men: First Class's CIA scene (Moira brings Charles and Raven to convince the CIA mutants exist) is set at CIA Headquarters in Langley, Virginia, not in Washington, D.C. Keep it on the Washington, D.C. pin as part of the capital area, or move it to its own Langley, Virginia place?
options: Keep on the Washington, D.C. pin (sub 'CIA')
Move to a new 'Langley' place in Virginia (about 38.95, -77.15)
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom's First Class page lists the locations as Langley, Virginia > CIA Headquarters; its CIA page says the agency is headquartered in Langley, Virginia, where Emma Frost is later held and freed. Langley is roughly 13 km from central D.C.
